assessments.topic: Chemical identities, direction and carrier classes
assessments.assessment: Fresh original XML-to-YAML comparison confirms 46 chemical sides and native physiological right-to-left RXN-23314. Thirteen small-molecule native InChIs match selected original ChEBI SQL assertions exactly. Native myxochelin A has a specified stereocenter absent from CHEBI:31877 and retains its narrower MetaCyc ID. B matches CHEBI:7061 by exact structure, without adopting contradictory prose. Six carrier states are native Protein classes and are not misrepresented as free metabolites or fully formulated polypeptides.

The preserved independently reviewed source audit reports zero elemental/charge residual for all nine reactions using explicitly symbolic carrier scaffolds, and carrier cancellation for both product nets. Each product requires two DHB activation/loading cycles and one lysine activation, hence three ATP-to-AMP events; A uses two NADPH, B uses one NADPH plus glutamate. These are derived stoichiometric accounting results, not measured yields, whole-protein formulas or energetics.

Fresh reading of the complete relevant 2001 Methods/Results/Discussion and Figure 5 supports E/F/G reconstitution, lysine activation/loading, two condensations, and reductive release. That paper directly identifies A; MxcL/B was proposed there. Fresh reading of all four 2008 SI pages supplies His6-MxcL/PLP spectra, E/F/G/L reconstitution producing A and B, and MS2/PFBHA methods for the free aldehyde. The unavailable 2005/2008 main bodies are not promoted to fully inspected paper evidence.

assessments.topic: Acylation order, assembly and regulation limits
assessments.assessment: N6-first is preserved as the native database representation while all relevant record claims qualify that 2001 Figure5C leaves the first lysine amide unresolved. The record does not assert a fixed E/F/G/L complex, a fixed number of carrier molecules, a demonstrated MxcL-MxcG assembly, a cellular compartment or regulatory edges. Concentration-dependent product partition in the SI is not treated as proof of a complex.

assessments.topic: Native strain, exact proteins and assay constructs
assessments.assessment: Fresh NCBI AF299336.1 parsing confirms Sg a15/taxon675526 source and all four versioned CDS translations exactly match UniProt Q9F638/Q9F637/Q9F636/Q9F631 lengths543/311/1456/420. UniProt entries remain species-level taxon41 and unreviewed. 2001 chromosomal E/F/G amplification, cleaved initiation residues and residual vector extensions are explicit; 2008 MxcL derives from pCBP-MxcL with His6 tag and does not establish a fully reconstructed native assay construct.

E enables DHB activation/loading; G enables lysine activation/loading, both condensations and reductive branches; F enables delivery as a carrier, not a separately inferred transferase. MxcF and isolated PCPG gain about340Da after heterologous MtaA coexpression; this does not identify the native Sga15 PPTase or prove full-length G occupancy. Electronic UniProt phosphopantetheine annotations retain their evidence tier. MxcL PLP binding has direct SI spectroscopy, whereas Mg is an assay ingredient without a claimed binding edge. Slower NADH activity stays an alternative assay context, without redefining exact native NADPH reactions.
